heroText: Suva is a Fiji base best planned around named sights rather than a generic stopover. Start with Fiji Museum, add Thurston Gardens, and use Suva Municipal Market to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Nausori International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: More than a tenth of this land area, 575 km2 (222 sq mi), was near Suva.

In 1868, when Suva was still a small village, the Bauan chieftain, Seru Epenisa Cakobau, granted 5,000 km2 (1,900 sq mi) of land to the Australian-based Polynesia Company, in exchange for the company's promise.
In 1874, control of the Fiji Islands was ceded to the United Kingdom.
Pratt of the Royal Engineers was appointed Surveyor-General in 1875 and designed the new capital in Suva, assisted by W.
In 1877, the colonial authorities moved the capital to Suva from Levuka, Ovalau, Lomaiviti, because Levuka's location between a steep mountain and the sea made any expansion of the town impractical.
The transfer of the administration to Suva was made official in 1882.
In 1910, Suva acquired the status of a municipality, under the Municipal Constitution Ordinance of 1909.
Its area remained one square mile until 1952, when Suva annexed the Muanikau and Samabula wards, expanding its territory to 13 km2 (5.0 sq mi).
Suva hosted the South Pacific Games in 2003 for the third time in the event's 40-year history.
